name: Bridgehollow warden-ring burgher house (winter)
description: Warden's Ring: grey stone ground storey with pale quoins and a weathered string course, close-studded oak upper storey and gables on limewash, steep slate roof with gabled dormers both sides, two ridge chimneys, carved finials, leaded casements with shutters, round-arched stone doorway. Winter: snow on the roof and dormer roofs.
